faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Serpixa
faq.answer1: We offer two main plans: Starter Pack and Premium Pack. The Starter Pack is perfect for getting started with SEO audits, while the Premium Pack includes advanced features with more audits and AI generations. Both plans include access to all core features.
faq.question2: How accurate are the SEO audit results?
faq.answer2: Our SEO audits use industry-standard algorithms and regularly updated data sources to provide reliable keyword tracking and thorough on-page analysis.
faq.question3: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
faq.answer3: Yes, you can cancel your subscription at any time. There are no long-term contracts, and you'll continue to have access until the end of your billing period.
faq.question4: What makes your AI content generation different?
faq.answer4: Our AI content is specifically trained for SEO optimization. It generates content with proper keyword density, meta tags, FAQ sections, and CTAs - all optimized for search engines while maintaining high quality.
faq.question5: Do you offer support for enterprise customers?
faq.answer5: Yes, we offer dedicated support, custom integrations, and tailored solutions for enterprise customers. Contact our sales team to discuss your specific needs.
faq.answer6: Simply create an account, choose between Starter Pack or Premium Pack based on your needs, and start running your first audit or generating content. Our intuitive interface makes it easy to get started in minutes.

ourStory.paragraph1: Serpixa was born from a simple observation: SEO tools were either too complex for small businesses or too expensive for growing companies. We saw a gap in the market for a platform that combines powerful analytics with ease of use.
